description: Shared undirected projection for GraphForge visualization examples (#298).

layout.note: Libraries that support a layout seed should use 42; others document the limitation.

query.nodes: MATCH (n:Member) RETURN n.club_id AS club_id, n.label AS label ORDER BY club_id
query.edges: MATCH (a:Member)-[:FRIEND]-(b:Member) WHERE a.club_id < b.club_id RETURN a.club_id AS source, b.club_id AS target ORDER BY source, target
